title: strategy-version
description: NX-043 X1 (design §3, D1): one version of a strategy an experiment compares. Only low-risk levers (D1): follow-up timing in hours, a choice among published operator persona versions, and switches of listed non-marketing outreach purposes. Price, incentives and marketing consent are no lever; any other lever is refused (lever_not_allowed). The persona version must be published and every purpose must be a listed purpose that is not marketing and needs no consent, checked by the server against the tenant. The owner publishes a version through a governed Action; the server assigns the version, freezes it and keeps its status as appended events (published, retired). A strategy decides nothing about real dispatch.
